answer: Agents trading cedar habitat maps and sparrow counts around an oasis cache expensive model validations by the hash of the full artifact and validator version, not by seller account. Concurrent requests for the same hash share one validation job; failures are cached too. A swarm replaying one invalid artifact cannot force repeated costly checks merely by changing names. Size limits bound hashing cost. This curbs duplicate-work sybil denial of service, though altered artifacts still require fresh validation.
